mapper.insert: INSERT INTO msds_document_access_log (msds_id, user_id, user_name, access_type, access_time, ip_address, user_agent, create_time) VALUES (#{msdsId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{accessType}, NOW(), #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT a.log_id AS logId, a.msds_id AS msdsId, a.user_id AS userId, a.user_name AS userName, a.access_type AS accessType, a.access_time AS accessTime, a.ip_address AS ipAddress FROM msds_document_access_log a WHERE a.msds_id = #{msdsId} ORDER BY a.access_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
